subject: Sharing a dashboard externally with an auditor
body: Our external auditor needs read-only access to two of our dashboards for the annual review next week, without a full seat license if possible. Is there a guest or share-link option that would work, and if so, does it expire automatically after a set period? Would rather not create a permanent seat for a two-week engagement.

subject: API returning 500 errors intermittently since yesterday
body: Since yesterday afternoon we've had our integration job fail with a 500 error roughly one call in five, on the same endpoint that was working fine last week - no changes on our side. We've added retry logic to get around it for now, but it's adding noise to our error logs that we'd rather not have. Could someone check whether something changed on the API side around the 27th?

subject: Data connector dropping rows on sync
body: Our Salesforce connector has been silently dropping rows on sync for at least the past week - we only noticed because our pipeline totals didn't match the source system, roughly 3-5% of records missing each run with no error surfaced anywhere. We've had to build a reconciliation check on our end just to catch this, which isn't something we should need for a standard scheduled sync. This needs a proper look, not just a re-sync.

subject: Connector row-drop issue - following up
body: Following up on the row-drop issue from last week - the re-sync you suggested worked temporarily but it happened again on Monday's run, same pattern, a handful of records missing with nothing logged. We've now built a standing manual export as a cross-check after every sync, which is extra work but at least it's reliable. A couple of people on the team have started just pulling straight into Excel for the affected reports rather than trusting the connector output.

subject: Circling back on the API errors from May
body: Circling back on the intermittent 500 errors from May - they never fully went away, they just became less frequent, maybe one call in twenty now rather than one in five. Our retry logic absorbs it without any real impact, so this isn't pressing, but between this and the connector issue in June we've settled into using Excel as the reliable fallback for a couple of the affected reports. No need to prioritise, just keeping it on record.

subject: Alerts occasionally not firing - low priority
body: One more small one to log - a couple of our budget alerts didn't fire this week despite the threshold being crossed, which we only caught because we happen to check the underlying numbers manually in Excel anyway these days. Given everything else we've flagged this year, we're not chasing this one hard, just wanted it recorded in case it fits a pattern you're already looking into.

subject: Report builder - pivot table question
body: Trying to replicate a pivot-style summary in report builder. Is there a recommended approach, or is this better done in the dashboard view?

subject: Dashboard sharing with external auditor
body: Our external auditor needs read-only access to one dashboard for two weeks. What's the best way to set this up without giving them a full seat?

subject: Feature request - export watermarking
body: Following the auditor access question last week, it would help to have an option to watermark exported PDFs as 'confidential' or similar for external shares.

subject: Feature request - version history on reports
body: Would be useful to see a version history on report templates, so we can tell who changed what and roll back if needed. A few of our reports have been edited unexpectedly this quarter.

subject: Alert setup for year-end close
body: Setting up a few temporary alerts for the year-end close process - thresholds on late journal entries. Wanted to check whether alerts can auto-expire after a given date so we don't have to remember to remove them.

subject: Alert not sending to correct email address
body:
Hello, we have an operations alert configured to send to our team distribution list but it appears to be routing to an individual email that was removed from the configuration several months ago. Could you check whether there is a caching or routing issue on the alert notification settings? Account is ACC0500.

Sanna Strand
Head of Operations

subject: New connector setup - authentication error
body:
Hi, trying to set up a new connector to our Salesforce instance and getting an OAuth authentication error on the authorisation step. Error code: SF_OAUTH_001. The credentials are correct — I can log into Salesforce with the same account. Is there a known issue with Salesforce OAuth integration, or is there a specific permission level required on the Salesforce side?

Sanna

subject: User role permissions - viewer vs editor access
body:
Hello,

I am in the process of onboarding several new team members to the platform. I want to assign them Viewer access only — they should be able to see dashboards and reports but not create or modify anything. However, when I tested with a Viewer account it was able to edit dashboard filter settings and save them, which I would not expect to be permitted under a read-only role.

Is the Viewer role intended to allow saved filter changes? If not, this seems like a permissions misconfiguration. I would like to get the roles correctly set before completing the onboarding.

Sanna Strand
Head of Operations

subject: Export file size limit being hit on monthly reports
body:
We are running into a file size limit when exporting our monthly operations reports. The export fails silently — no error message, the file just does not appear in the download queue. After some testing it seems to happen on reports over roughly 50,000 rows. Is there a documented row or file size limit on Standard plan exports? If so, can this be increased or is it a hard limit? We run these exports monthly and they have been working fine until recently — either the report grew larger or something changed on the platform side.

This is blocking a report delivery I needed this week. Please prioritise.

Sanna Strand

subject: Alerts module - rules disappearing after saving
body:
Hello,

I am having an issue where alert rules are not persisting after I save them. I create the rule, click save, the UI confirms it was saved, but when I navigate away and come back the rule is not listed. This has happened four times across two different browsers so it is not a local caching issue.

We had alert routing issues in December which were resolved, but this feels like a different problem. It is affecting our operations monitoring — we have alerts we need in place that simply are not sticking. I would appreciate a prompt response.

Sanna

subject: Dashboard widgets not refreshing on schedule
body:
Several widgets on our main operations dashboard have stopped auto-refreshing. They are configured to refresh every 30 minutes but the data is static — last updated timestamps are not changing. I have tried manually refreshing the page and the data does update, so the underlying connector is fine. This is the same dashboard that had load time acceptable until now. The auto-refresh failure means team members are not seeing current data unless they manually reload, which defeats the purpose of having a live operations view.

Sanna Strand

subject: Export failing again - same issue as January
body:
The export failure is back. Same report, same error (or rather, same silent failure). The row count has not changed substantially. We had this fixed in January and apparently it has broken again.

I need this export for a report due Friday. Please escalate.

Sanna

subject: Export issue still not resolved - this is the third time
body:
This is now the third time I have raised an export failure for the same report. The previous ticket (April 11) was marked resolved but the fix has not held — the export failed again this morning.

I understand support queues are busy but I need someone to actually diagnose the root cause rather than apply a temporary fix. My team depends on this export for monthly operations reporting and we cannot keep treating a recurring fault as a new incident each time. I would like to speak with someone at a senior technical level, not just receive a "please try again" response.

Sanna Strand
Head of Operations

subject: API endpoint returning 500 errors intermittently
body:
Our development team is getting intermittent 500 errors from the /exports/trigger endpoint. The calls are formatted correctly — they work most of the time but fail unpredictably, roughly once every 10-15 calls. No pattern in time of day.

Given that we are also dealing with the export UI failures, I am starting to wonder whether there is a broader issue with the exports infrastructure. I want this documented separately in case it is relevant.

Sanna

subject: Alert configuration reset again
body:
Alert rules reset again. Third or fourth time this year. Please fix it.

Sanna

subject: Report builder performance degraded on complex reports
body:
Hello,

I wanted to log a performance issue with the Report builder. Our main operations summary report, which has around 20 fields and three calculated metrics, now takes over two minutes to generate a preview. Six months ago this was under 30 seconds. We have not substantially changed the report structure.

I am raising this because the slow previews are reducing how often the team uses the builder for ad hoc work — it is simply not practical to wait two minutes to see whether a change to a filter or metric looks correct. We have had a number of platform issues this year and I want to make sure this one is on record even though it is not an outright failure. Resolution time on this ticket is not urgent, but I do want it tracked.

Sanna Strand

subject: API token expiry behaviour
body:
API tokens are expiring earlier than the configured expiry period. Configured for 90 days, but seeing expiry after approximately 30 days. Please confirm expected token lifetime for Standard accounts and whether anything changed recently.

Sanna

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions not working correctly
body:
Users with Viewer role are seeing an error when opening shared dashboard links: "Access denied, contact your administrator." The sharing permissions on these dashboards include all users. This started in the last few days. Not a new dashboard — these have been shared and working for months.

Sanna Strand
